_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Siz O'yinchi {player_id}, Iterated Ultimatum O'yinining {num_rounds} raundini o'ynaysiz.
Siz ushbu raundni o'zingiz va O'yinchi {other_id} o'rtasida {pool}$ bo'lishish uchun ega siz.

Taklif qiluvchi:
  - Taklif qil: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pul)
  - Qabul qilinsa → Sizga (pul - X)$, boshqa o'yinchiga X$
  - Rad qilinsa → Ikkala o'yinchi ham 0$
  - Misol: [Offer: $3]  yaki  'Menga bu adil ko'rinadi. [Offer: $5]'

Javob beruvchi:
  - Taklif bilan [Accept] yaki [Reject] bilan qaror qabul qil
  - Misol: 'Buni ma'qul ko'raman. [Accept]'
            'Juda adolatsiz. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Round {round_number} begins! ---
Player {proposer_id} is the proposer, Player {responder_id} is the responder.
round.accepted: O'yinchi {responder_id} qabul qildi! Raund {round_number} foydasi: O'yinchi {proposer_id} +{proposer_gain}$, O'yinchi {responder_id} +{responder_gain}$. Yangi jamlar: O'yinchi 0: {total_0}$, O'yinchi 1: {total_1}$.
round.rejected: O'yinchi {responder_id} taklifni rad etdi! Raund {round_number} foydasi: Ikkala o'yinchi ham 0$. Jamlar saqlanadi: O'yinchi 0: {total_0}$, O'yinchi 1: {total_1}$.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: تەكلىپ قىلغۇچى چوقۇم [Offer: $X] شەكلىدە بىر تەكلىپنى بېرىشى كېرەك.
invalid_move.bad_integer: بۇ بىر پۈتۈن سان بولۇشى كېرەك.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: ھازىرچە جاۋاب قايتۇرغىلى بولمايدىغان بىر تەكلىپمۇ يوق.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Jawapker [Accept] yaki [Reject] taklifni qabul qilishi yaki rad etishi kerak.

outcome.win: Player {winner} won with ${winner_total} total vs Player {loser}'s ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: تەڭلەڭ! ھەر ئىككىسى جەمئىي ${total} بىلەن ئاخىرلاشتى.
